objective: Port the API layer of netty-codec-classes-quic 4.2.19.Final (io.netty.handler.codec.quic) to Netty.NET.Handler.Codec.Quic with the original names, structure, comments and tests (stage 1), record the quiche/BoringSSL JNI units as jvm-only-replaced, and port the codec builders, the channel bootstrap and QuicSslContextBuilder on the System.Net.Quic (msquic) implementation, recording the datagram machinery msquic owns (stage 2, docs/codec-classes-quic-porting.md).

ownerDecisions: Project, folder and assembly names are the namespace root of the module (owner decision 2026-11-19, see docs/codec-base-porting.md): each codec module takes the namespace of its main package, and the tests use <project>.Tests like the other test projects.

Owner decisions 2026-11-27 for QUIC (docs/quic-design.md): the project and namespace are Netty.NET.Handler.Codec.Quic (one project per Maven module; it references Netty.NET.Handler); the model is listener-based on System.Net.Quic (msquic); quiche and BoringSSL (JNI) are not ported and their units are jvm-only-replaced; API features that System.Net.Quic lacks keep their Java API and the msquic implementation reports them as unsupported; the platforms are Windows and Linux.

statusMeaning.verified: Every declared original test is mapped to a C# test with the same name (case may differ) and passes.
statusMeaning.clr-adapted: Ported with the original names, structure and comments; every CLR difference is stated in a // CLR: comment and in this entry.
statusMeaning.jvm-only-replaced: JVM-only unit (the quiche/BoringSSL JNI binding) or metadata/documentation unit replaced by its recorded CLR counterpart.

The engine of a QUIC connection holds the options its QuicSslContext built (ClientAuthenticationOptions()/ServerAuthenticationOptions(), exactly one non-null; GetUseClientMode(), GetPeerHost(), GetPeerPort()), which stage 2 hands to QuicClientConnectionOptions/QuicServerConnectionOptions, and the facts negotiated in the handshake, which stage 2 records from the QuicConnection: GetApplicationProtocol() (NegotiatedApplicationProtocol), GetPeerCertificates() (RemoteCertificate with its chain), GetCipherSuite() (NegotiatedCipherSuite, TlsCipherSuite) and GetProtocol() (SslProtocol). The members are CLR-only abstract members named after the SSLEngine/SSLSession accessors; wrap/unwrap and the other engine members have no counterpart.

Public interface IQuicSslSessionContext with SetTicketKeys(params SslSessionTicketKey[]). SSLSessionContext has no counterpart (SslContext.sessionContext() is not ported, owner decision 2026-11-24 decision 2), so the interface has no base interface; session ticket keys have no System.Net.Quic counterpart and stage 2 reports them as unsupported.

The error-code overloads of shutdown/shutdownInput/shutdownOutput fold with their ChannelPromise overloads into ShutdownAsync(int), ShutdownInputAsync(int) and ShutdownOutputAsync(int) (the IDuplexChannel shape, no CancellationToken); updatePriority is UpdatePriorityAsync(priority, CancellationToken).
